command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0053/fixture.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Six EVEX vmovaps instructions with an index, a scale and no base, one per 0.24.0 row, eleven bytes each (66 bytes total). In every instruction ModRM is 04 (mod 00, r/m 100) and the SIB byte's base field is the constant 101, which at mod 00 means "no base, disp32"; the displacement slot is therefore present even when its content is zero (instruction 1). The SIB byte holds the scale at bits 7-6 and the index at bits 5-3, and the index's fourth bit is the inverted X-bar in P0 at [14,1] (62 b1 for %r12 as the index, 62 31 for %r13 and %r15). The vector register sits in the five-bit field at [43,3] plus the inverted R-bar/R-bar-prime bits at [12,1]/[15,1]. disp32 operands carry bytes: instruction 3 is -4096 and instruction 6 is the signed end point 2147483647. The fixture uses all four scale contents (0, 1, 2 and 3) and index %rax/%rcx/%rsi/%r12/%r13/%r15, so both the three-bit field and X-bar are exercised. input_sha256 is fixture.asm (the source above); output_sha256 is the 66-byte .text.
